connection: A fresh sqlite3 connection is opened per request via get_connection() in db.py; raw SQL, no ORM.
queries: Lookups and updates against the members table by member id.
transactions: One implicit transaction per request, committed after each update.
n_plus_one: None in the original single-member flows.
concurrency: None; sqlite3 default isolation with no explicit locking.

optimization_targets.description: Add a bulk_renew_endpoint that accepts a list of member ids and months and renews each membership, extending the expiry logic already present in renew_member_endpoint.

notes: The new endpoint must iterate the member ids, extend each membership by the requested months, persist the new expiry dates, and return per-member results.
